author: Home RenoVision DIY
description:
If you're building a new shower or renovating your bathroom, what's the smartest way to do it without wasting money or worrying about leaks? I'm comparing the most popular shower pans, wall boards, and waterproofing systems, including Schluter KERDI, Wedi, GoBoard, Tile Redi, cement board, AquaDefense, and PROVA. Watch next - https://youtu.be/iRne0ClsA8o
I'll be breaking down the costs, installation methods, and pros and cons of each so you can choose the right materials for your DIY shower renovation. After 35+ years in construction, I'll also show you which combination of products I actually chose for the shower in my own Forever Home and why.

Tile Redi Pan - https://bit.ly/tilerediflatbottom (the flat bottom technology allows you to install with thin set)
